propertyTypes.name: core.display_name
propertyTypes.description: A human-readable name of a party, item, or place.

propertyTypes.name: core.code
propertyTypes.description: A business code or key assigned by the source system (customer code, item code).

propertyTypes.name: core.document_number
propertyTypes.description: The number a business document carries (order, invoice, payment reference).

propertyTypes.name: core.phone_number
propertyTypes.description: A telephone number as written by its source; E.164 when normalized.

propertyTypes.name: core.money_amount
propertyTypes.description: A monetary amount. Money is a pair: an amount of this type and an iso4217.currency_code beside it.

propertyTypes.name: core.quantity
propertyTypes.description: A quantity of an item, in the unit recorded beside it.

propertyTypes.name: core.national_id
propertyTypes.description: A government-issued personal identifier, as reported by its source.

propertyTypes.name: core.bank_account_number
propertyTypes.description: A bank account identifier, as reported by its source.

propertyTypes.name: core.health_information
propertyTypes.description: A health-related record or finding represented as source JSON.
